page.title: Prices & Stocks
page.description: Manage prices, stock, minimum stay, and room availability per date

table.soldTitle: Counts rooms on Pending, Confirmed, and Checked-in reservations

helper.body: For a single date, edit Price, Sellable Stock, Min. Night, or Stop Sell directly on that date's row then click Save Changes. Dates that have not been set up require Price and Sellable Stock first. Capacity of {roomName}: the Sellable Stock limit follows {stockLimit} active rooms. Occupied and cleaning rooms are still part of the operational count in the API. Sold counts rooms booked on Pending, Confirmed, or Checked-in status. Remaining Stock and Available Rooms are calculated by the API based on reservations and room status. Website and Front Desk promos follow Campaigns & Promotions.
